summary: Dispatched via codex exec --sandbox read-only -c model_reasoning_effort=high against the frozen diff (git diff main..HEAD -- .github/workflows/tests.yml, commit 3633449867). Found 2 real findings, both applied in a follow-up commit (1020b4d682): (1) classifier_trusted/override_active job outputs used a bare `|| 'false'` fallback, which only normalizes an EMPTY left side, not an unexpected non-empty one -- fixed with explicit `== 'true' && 'true' || 'false'`. (2) the new classifier-corpus-visibility job's exit 1 is not guaranteed non-blocking under every branch-protection/ruleset shape -- recommended continue-on-error: true, applied. Confirmed the heredoc indentation and the job-level if: expression were both correct as written.

Dispatched via scripts/tp1_call.py --model qwen3.8-max --effort medium against the same frozen diff post-fix (commit 1020b4d682). Verdict LGTM, no blocking findings. One dissenting technical claim: this seat argued continue-on-error: true on the classifier-corpus-visibility job would mask its own check-run conclusion and should be omitted. Independently empirically tested on a throwaway branch/PR (#5701, closed unmerged) with the extraction deliberately broken: the job's check-run conclusion reported failure (verified via both `gh pr checks` and the raw Checks API `check-runs` endpoint) WITH continue-on-error: true still set -- this seat's specific claim about masking did not hold on this repo's live runner behavior. codex-gpt-5.6-sol's recommendation (keep continue-on-error: true, it only affects the aggregate workflow-run conclusion, not the individual check-run) was the one confirmed correct by the empirical test.
